description: This file contains unit tests for the Ofbiz startup command parser, verifying command parsing logic, argument validation, and the handling of multiple command inputs.

classes.name: OfbizStartupUnitTests
classes.description: Contains JUnit test cases for testing command parsing and argument validation in the Ofbiz startup utility.

methods.name: commandParserDoesNotAcceptMoreThanOneCommand
methods.description: Tests that the command parser throws an exception if multiple commands are specified simultaneously.

methods.name: commandParserDoesNotAcceptPortoffsetWithoutArgument
methods.description: Ensures that missing argument for the port offset option results in an exception.

methods.name: commandParserDoesNotAcceptPortoffsetWithoutPositiveInteger
methods.description: Checks that non-integer port offset values cause a validation exception.

methods.name: commandParserDoesNotAcceptArgumentForStatus
methods.description: Verifies that providing an argument for the --status command results in an error.

methods.name: commandParserDoesNotAcceptArgumentForStart
methods.description: Verifies that providing an argument for the --start command results in an error.

methods.name: commandParserDoesNotAcceptArgumentForShutdown
methods.description: Verifies that providing an argument for the --shutdown command results in an error.

methods.name: commandParserCombinesMultipleArgsIntoOneCommand
methods.description: Tests that multiple command-line arguments are correctly combined into a single StartupCommand object with proper properties.
